import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('user_credentials.db')

for row in cur.fetchall():
    print('TABLE:', row['name'])
    print(row['sql'])
    print('---')

    for r in cur2.fetchall():
        print(dict(r))
    print('====================')

import os, sqlite3, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import login_script

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
db = tmp / "smoke.db"
os.environ["USER_CREDENTIALS_DB"] = str(db)

# Fake interactive password entry for the CLI paths.
login_script.getpass.getpass = lambda prompt="": "s3cret-pass!"

# 1) Register via the public API against a temp DB.
conn = sqlite3.connect(db)
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
login_script.ensure_schema(conn)
uid = login_script.register_user(conn, "alice", "alice@example.com", "s3cret-pass!")
row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?", (uid,)).fetchone()
assert row["username"] == "alice"
assert row["password_hash"] == login_script.hash_password("s3cret-pass!")
assert login_script.verify_user(conn, "alice", "s3cret-pass!") is True
assert login_script.verify_user(conn, "alice@example.com", "s3cret-pass!") is True
assert login_script.verify_user(conn, "alice", "wrong!") is False
try:
    login_script.register_user(conn, "alice", "bob@example.com", "whatever123")
    raise SystemExit("FAIL: duplicate username accepted")
except ValueError:
    pass
conn.close()

# 2) Full CLI flows (register -> login -> wrong password) via main().
assert login_script.main(["register", "--username", "carol", "--email", "carol@example.com"]) == 0
assert login_script.main(["login", "--identifier", "carol"]) == 0
assert login_script.main(["login", "--identifier", "carol@example.com"]) == 0
login_script.getpass.getpass = lambda prompt="": "wrong-password!"
assert login_script.main(["login", "--identifier", "carol"]) == 1

print("ALL STDLIB SMOKE TESTS PASSED (temp DB only, real user_credentials.db untouched)")
EOF
